出生地: 印度,安得拉邦,海得拉巴
简介: Adivi Sesh Sunny Chandra is an Indian film actor, director and screenwriter who primarily works in Telugu cinema. He made his film debut as a lead actor and director in 2010 with Karma: Do You Believe?. Following a few supporting roles and negative characters, he became a notable lead actor in Telugu films.
